goal: Prevent chainstate and indexes from advancing when writing block or undo data to disk fails
Avoids silent database corruption and state desynchronization when disk write errors occur
agreement: Substantive support and verification from multiple reviewers (arejula27, optout21, pzafonte)
Concept approval highlighting corruption risks when block storage sync fails permanently (mzumsande)
Verified locally and confirmed the unit test fails without the behavioral fix (optout21)
Open question on whether retried flushes should succeed after shutdown is requested (arejula27)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it halts chainstate flush on disk errors to prevent metadata corruption and desynchronization
Protects node integrity when using separate block directories where block disk sync can fail independently
